turns.user_text: Name one term someone reading about requiring versus dropping standardized test scores would need to know, and define it. Answer in four or five sentences.
turns.model_text: One term someone reading about requiring versus dropping standardized test scores would need to know is "test-optional policy." A test-optional policy is a college admissions policy that allows students to choose whether or not to submit their standardized test scores as part of their application. This policy is often implemented in response to concerns about the fairness and validity of standardized testing, and it aims to provide students with more flexibility and autonomy in the application process. By making test scores optional, colleges can attract a more diverse pool of applicants and reduce the emphasis on standardized testing.
